shapeSummary: Brushed DC motor modeled with its long axis along Z, centered at X=0 and Z=0, with the bottom at Y=0 and the motor axis at Y=21. It has a 36 mm diameter body, a 30 mm diameter rear encoder cover, a 42x42x4 mm square mount plate with four 4 mm corner holes at ±16 mm, and an 8 mm across-flats hex shaft that protrudes 32 mm from the mount face. The part spans Z -50 to 50.
warnings: The only stated dimension is the 32 mm shaft protrusion. All other sizes are visual estimates.
The 3.175 mm shaft_diameter in the metadata conflicts with the 8mm REX shaft and was ignored.
The Coke can dimensions are nonsensical and were not used for scale.
The plate is simplified to a square. The four-point star outline, brass inserts, center bore, M3 face-screw holes and the shaft boss were omitted.
Lead wires, connectors, labels and the encoder cover details were omitted.
The shaft is a plain hexagon, not the true round REX profile, and the shaft end tapped hole was omitted.
Body length and cover length are guesses.
The Z axis is the long axis (from the analysis) and Y is the vertical axis for the bottom-at-Y=0 rule.
